title: Klarna vs. Your Credit Score: Is It Worth the Convenience?
summary: UK-focused explainer on whether Klarna affects a user's credit score under its different repayment options.

assertions.quote: if you consistently make your payments on time it will have a positive effect on your credit score

verdicts.note: Reflects how UK-regulated buy now pay later credit agreements, distinct from short pay-in-three/four plans, are described by the provider.

assertions.quote: multiple hard searches within a short period of time can seriously affect your credit score

verdicts.note: Multiple hard inquiries in a short window are a standard, well-documented factor that can lower a credit score.

assertions.quote: Clana may pass your debt onto a collection agency... this will further damage your credit score

verdicts.note: CFPB: all five surveyed lenders have used third-party debt collectors to collect delinquent balances, with one common industry practice being to refer loans to collectors after they reach charged-off status.

assertions.quote: if a collection agency seeks a county court judgment... it will have an even greater negative impact

verdicts.note: A county court judgment is a more severe public record than a missed payment alone and weighs more heavily on a credit file.
